incantations: Sanzai suru kemono no hone! Sentō, kōshō, kōtetsu no sharin. Ugokeba kaze, tomareba sora. Yari utsu neiro ga kojō ni michiru!
Bones of beasts, lying scattered! Spire, crimson crystal, wheel of steel. When it moves, wind; when it stops, sky. Spears strike, and their tone fills the hollow castle!
Sanzai suru kemono no hone! Sentō, kōshō, kōtetsu no sharin. Ugokeba kaze, tomareba sora. Yari utsu neiro ga kyōjō ni michiru!
